note: 坐标为近似位置，仅用于研学导览示意；同一校区内的点位按方位做了小幅偏移，避免地标重叠。新增点位与照片来自团队 2026-10-31 城南校区实拍。

school.name: 湖南省立第一师范学校旧址
school.name_en: Site of Hunan First Normal School
school.addr: 长沙市天心区书院路 356 号
school.intro: 一师核心校区，前身是南宋城南书院。毛泽东在此求学、执教共八年，校训「实事求是」影响了他的一生。
school.intro_en: The core campus of Hunan First Normal School, whose predecessor was Chengnan Academy of the Southern Song. Mao studied and taught here for eight years; the motto 'seeking truth from facts' shaped his life.

class8.name: 第八班教室
class8.addr: 第一师范旧址教学楼二层（第八班教室）
class8.addr_en: Second floor, teaching building of the school site
class8.intro: 毛泽东在一师求学时的固定教室，第一行第四座是他的座位。
class8.intro_en: Mao's fixed classroom; the fourth seat in the first row was his.

well.name: 一师水井
well.addr: 第一师范旧址院内水井
well.addr_en: In the courtyard of the school site
well.intro: 毛泽东常年在此进行冷水浴，四季不断，是他「野蛮其体魄」的具体实践。
well.intro_en: Mao took cold-water baths here all year round — a concrete practice of 'toughening the body'.

pavilion.name: 君子亭
pavilion.addr_en: On the campus of the school site
pavilion.intro: 毛泽东常在此读书，并与同学探讨国家大事。
pavilion.intro_en: Mao often read here and discussed national affairs with classmates.

hall.name: 大礼堂
hall.addr_en: On the campus of the school site
hall.intro: 校内举行集会、演讲及学术活动的重要场所。
hall.intro_en: An important venue for assemblies, speeches and academic activities.

readingroom.name: 阅报室
readingroom.addr_en: On the campus of the school site
readingroom.intro: 毛泽东在一师期间每天必去的地方，在此读报、关心天下时政。
readingroom.intro_en: Where Mao went every day to read newspapers and follow current affairs.

chengnan.name: 城南书院
chengnan.addr: 长沙市天心区（第一师范旧址内）
chengnan.addr_en: Tianxin District, Changsha (within the school site)
chengnan.intro: 一师前身，南宋始建，体现「千年学府、百年师范」的湖湘文脉。
chengnan.intro_en: The school's predecessor, founded in the Southern Song, embodying a thousand-year academy and a century-old normal school.

xinmin.name: 新民学会成立会旧址
xinmin.name_en: Site of the Founding of the New People's Study Society
xinmin.addr: 长沙市岳麓区溁湾镇刘家台子（蔡和森故居）
xinmin.addr_en: Liujiataizi, Yingwan Town, Yuelu District, Changsha
xinmin.intro: 1918 年 4 月，毛泽东、蔡和森、萧子升等在此发起成立新民学会，萧子升任首任总干事，何叔衡是最年长的会员。
xinmin.intro_en: In April 1918 Mao, Cai Hesen and Xiao Zisheng founded the New People's Study Society here; Xiao was its first secretary-general and He Shuheng its oldest member.

paifang.name: 城南书院石坊
paifang.addr: 第一师范城南书院校区北门（城南书院石坊）
paifang.addr_en: North gate of the Chengnan campus (Chengnan Academy archway)
paifang.intro: 石坊门额题「城南书院」，是追溯一师前身千年文脉的起点；穿过石坊即进入校区。
paifang.intro_en: The archway is inscribed "Chengnan Academy" — the starting point for tracing the school's thousand-year lineage.

statue.name: 毛泽东铜像广场
statue.addr: 第一师范城南书院校区 · 毛泽东铜像广场
statue.addr_en: Mao Zedong Statue Square, Chengnan campus
statue.intro: 青年毛泽东铜像立于广场中央，是研学集合、献花与合影的主要场所。
statue.intro_en: A bronze statue of the young Mao stands at the centre of the square — the main meeting point for study groups.

dorm8.name: 第八班寝室
dorm8.addr: 第一师范城南书院校区 · 第八班寝室
dorm8.addr_en: Dormitory of Class Eight, Chengnan campus
dorm8.intro: 通铺复原陈列，毛泽东的床位在靠窗一侧；「三不谈」的故事就发生在这里。
dorm8.intro_en: The restored communal dormitory; Mao's bed was by the window, where the 'three no-talks' story took place.

courtyard.name: 校园中庭
courtyard.addr: 第一师范城南书院校区 · 校园中庭
courtyard.intro: 「名师熏陶，益友砥砺」铜像群，再现毛泽东与师友切磋问学的场景。
courtyard.intro_en: The sculpture group "Nurtured by great teachers, sharpened by good friends" recreates Mao studying with teachers and classmates.

playground.name: 校园体育锻炼场
playground.addr: 第一师范城南书院校区 · 体育锻炼场
playground.intro: 木制单杠与沙坑保留至今，是毛泽东「野蛮其体魄」的现场证据。
playground.intro_en: Wooden horizontal bars and a sand pit survive here — on-site evidence of Mao's "toughening the body".

nightclass_site.name: 工人夜学旧址
nightclass_site.addr: 第一师范城南书院校区 · 工人夜学旧址
nightclass_site.addr_en: Night School for Workers site, Chengnan campus
nightclass_site.intro: 门额「工人夜学」与展板记录 1917 年毛泽东为工人免费授课的历史。
nightclass_site.intro_en: The door plaque and exhibition boards record Mao teaching workers free of charge in 1917.

houzishi.name: 猴子石缴枪
houzishi.name_en: Disarming the Warlord Troops at Houzishi
houzishi.addr: 长沙市天心区 · 猴子石（一师南郊）
houzishi.addr_en: Houzishi, Tianxin District, Changsha (south of the school)
houzishi.intro: 1917 年 11 月，毛泽东组织学生志愿军在此缴获北洋军溃兵枪支，是青年毛泽东早期军事实践的开端。
houzishi.intro_en: In November 1917 Mao led the student volunteers to disarm retreating Beiyang troops here — an early military action.

dfh_tianhan.name: 田汉剧场
dfh_tianhan.addr: 东方红校区 · 田汉剧场
dfh_tianhan.intro: 以校友田汉命名的剧场，是校园演出、讲座与文化活动的主要场地。
dfh_tianhan.intro_en: A theatre named after alumnus Tian Han, the main venue for performances, lectures and cultural events.

dfh_art.name: 美术馆
dfh_art.addr: 东方红校区 · 美术馆
dfh_art.intro: 展示师生美术作品与校史主题创作，是校园美育空间。
dfh_art.intro_en: Exhibitions of staff and student art and school-history-themed works — a campus space for aesthetic education.

dfh_library.name: 图书馆
dfh_library.addr: 东方红校区 · 图书馆
dfh_library.intro: 服务教学科研的校园图书馆，藏有师范教育、湖湘文化与红色文献。
dfh_library.intro_en: The campus library supporting teaching and research, with collections on teacher education, Huxiang culture and red documents.

dfh_runzhi.name: 润之广场
dfh_runzhi.addr: 东方红校区 · 润之广场
dfh_runzhi.intro: 以毛泽东字「润之」命名的广场，位于图书馆与纳湖之间，是校园核心景观与集会空间。
dfh_runzhi.intro_en: A square named after Mao's courtesy name Runzhi, between the library and Na Lake.

dfh_wall.name: 名人墙
dfh_wall.addr: 东方红校区 · 名人墙
dfh_wall.intro: 展示一师历史名师与杰出校友，串联校史人物与校园记忆。
dfh_wall.intro_en: Introducing the school's historic teachers and distinguished alumni, linking school history and campus memory.

routes.title: 半天经典线
routes.summary: 从石坊入校，串起第八班教室、水井与阅报室，用两小时读完毛泽东在一师的日常。
routes.summary_en: Enter through the stone archway and link Class Eight, the well and the reading room — Mao's daily life in two hours.
tasks: 在石坊下说出「城南书院—湖南师范—第一师范」的沿革。
在第八班教室找到毛泽东的座位，记录它与讲台的距离。
在水井旁读完说明牌，用一句话解释「冷水浴」与意志训练的关系。
在阅报室挑一份旧报影印件，说说它为什么会出现在一师。
tasks_en: Explain the sequence "Chengnan Academy — Hunan Normal College — First Normal School" under the archway.
Find Mao's seat in the Class Eight classroom and note its distance from the teacher's desk.
Read the well sign and explain in one sentence how cold-water baths trained the will.
Pick a newspaper facsimile in the reading room and say why it mattered at the school.

routes.title: 一日深度线
routes.summary: 一日走完主楼、城南书院、石坊、教室、寝室、大礼堂、中庭、水井与阅报室，适合班级集体研学。
routes.summary_en: A full day through the main building, academy wall, archway, classroom, dormitory, hall, courtyard, well and reading room — ideal for a class visit.
tasks: 用一张纸画出九站动线，标出你觉得最值得停留的一站。
在寝室复原场景里找出「三不谈」展板，抄下三条内容。
在大礼堂数一数长条凳的排数，估算当年集会的人数规模。
在中庭铜像群中选一位「师」和一位「友」，用图谱查出他们与毛泽东的关系。
tasks_en: Sketch the nine-stop route and mark the stop you would linger at longest.
Find the 'three no-talks' board in the dormitory and copy the three rules.
Count the rows of benches in the hall and estimate its assembly capacity.
Choose one teacher and one friend from the courtyard statues and look up their relations to Mao in the graph.

routes.title: 精神传承线
routes.summary: 从铜像广场出发，经中庭、阅报室、工人夜学旧址回到主楼，理解「师友—阅读—实践」的精神链条。
routes.summary_en: Start at the statue square, pass the courtyard, reading room and night-school site, and return to the main building to trace the chain "teachers and friends — reading — practice".
tasks: 在铜像前写下一句「我想成为什么样的人」。
在中庭石刻前解释「名师熏陶，益友砥砺」八个字。
在阅报室找一条 1919 年前后的湖南新闻，说说毛泽东为什么关注它。
在工人夜学门额前，用「教育救国」解释毛泽东办夜学的动机。
tasks_en: In front of the statue, write one sentence: "What kind of person do I want to become?"
Explain the eight characters "Nurtured by great teachers, sharpened by good friends" at the courtyard boulder.
Find a Hunan news item from around 1919 in the reading room and say why Mao cared about it.
Explain Mao's night school through the idea of 'saving the nation through education'.

routes.title: 青年报国线
routes.summary: 从主楼到铜像广场，再赴猴子石与工人夜学旧址，重走青年毛泽东「胆识—行动」的现场。
routes.summary_en: From the main building to the statue square, then to Houzishi and the night-school site — following the young Mao's courage and action.
tasks: 在猴子石场景前找出「造势」的三个细节，说明它们各自的作用。
讨论：一群学生为什么能缴获正规军的枪？
在工人夜学旧址对比「武装行动」与「教育行动」，说说两者共同的底色。
tasks_en: Find three details of the "show of force" at Houzishi and explain each one.
Discuss: how could a group of students disarm regular troops?
Compare the 'armed action' and the 'educational action' at the night-school site — what do they share?

routes.title: 东方红校区人文线
routes.summary: 在东方红校区从田汉剧场走到名人墙，用五站串起艺术、阅读、广场与校史人物。
routes.summary_en: From the Tian Han Theatre to the Celebrity Wall, five stops linking art, reading, public space and school history.
tasks: 在田汉剧场门口找出与田汉有关的介绍文字，记下他为一师留下的印记。
在美术馆选一件最喜欢的作品，说明它和「师范」「湖湘」有什么关系。
在图书馆找一本一师校史或湖湘文化相关的书，记下书名与索书号。
在润之广场读完地名牌，解释「润之」与毛泽东的关系。
在名人墙找一位你认识的校友，用知识图谱查出他与一师的关联。
tasks_en: Find the text about Tian Han at the theatre entrance and note his link with the school.
Choose a favourite work in the Art Museum and explain its link with teacher education or Huxiang culture.
Find a book on school history or Huxian culture in the library and note its title and call number.
Read the square's name plate and explain the relation between 'Runzhi' and Mao.
Find an alumnus you know on the Celebrity Wall and look up their link with the school in the graph.
